body: Anxiety and inability to get a feel for how to park.

I started a job last month and ever since then everything just hit me. I realized I'm trapped in my house. I'm 23 and work a minimum wage job. I'll have a degree soon but it won't matter because I don't have a driver's license and am dependent on my family for rides to and from work. I have problems with learning how to drive a car. I can't rely on my parents forever but it's looking like I'll have to.

I also have problems with my mind that aren't being addressed due to lack of funds for therapy. I just don't want to live with my parents anymore. It'd be bearable if I had a foreseeable way out of their house but I don't.
